title: A rebase that changes nothing voids the review
what: After a rebase whose patch is unchanged (git range-diff shows no change), the review and check records still count, so only a gate is needed; a rebase that changes the patch still voids them.
why: 25 Oct, the arsenal pilot design, scratchpad reports/design-arsenal.md (copy in ~/.relay/backup/scratch-3207dc59), risk 4: projects that rebase (arsenal's Master Sync) lose relay's review and check at every rebase, about +25 agent minutes and a new Opus review each time, roughly 10% of changes at arsenal's merge rate. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A branch with a review and check record is rebased onto a new main commit that touches an unrelated file; git range-diff shows no patch change; the merge hook refuses for a missing review of the new head.
pass_cases: The same rebase keeps the review and check valid (a new gate still required); a rebase that changes the patch still voids them.
where: lib/relay_verdict.py (around 643: a review whose reviewed commit is not in the head's history is refused)
